# Benchmarks

This folder contains benchmark artifacts for ZTARE's evaluator and
claim-discipline surfaces.

Start with [Benchmark Evidence](benchmark_evidence.md). It summarizes the
current public comparison evidence, including the PySR baseline from the
experimental-math letter and the constraint-memory evaluator benchmark. The
claim is intentionally narrow: these benchmarks support false-positive
suppression and null-returning gate discipline, not a broad public ranking
claim.
